# AMEVA Sovereign Ecosystem & Technical Architecture Documentation
> Machine-Readable AI Context & Technical Manifest for LLM RAG Agents, Autonomous Assistants, and Search Indexers.

## Project Summary
AMEVA (Autonomous Multi-Agent Enterprise Virtualized Automation) is a sovereign, edge-native AI ecosystem founded by [@uno-km](https://uno-km.vercel.app/). It provides on-device deep learning, browser-native WebGPU autograd, zero-root mobile automation, speech recognition, and LoRA training with zero cloud subscription costs and data sovereignty.

## Flagship Products & Core Open-Source Libraries

### 1. AMEVA Workstation Web (Web / Desktop)
- **Description**: Sovereign on-device WebGPU local AI workstation featuring Qwen2.5 (0.5B/1.5B/7B), 3-sec MapReduce PDF/DOCX summarizer, in-app video trimmer, and client-side background remover.
- **Runtime**: WebGPU, WebLLM, Pyodide WASM, Client-Side Vector Search.
- **Live App**: https://ameva-workstation-web-core.vercel.app/
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/app/workstation/

### 2. AMEVA-Forge
- **Description**: Browser-Native WebGPU deep learning autograd engine with drop-in PyTorch syntax compatibility and custom WGSL compute shaders.
- **Package**: PyPI `pip install ameva`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/forge/
- **Live Studio Demo**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/forge/demo.html
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/forge/llms.txt

### 3. Termux-STT
- **Description**: Unified on-device speech-to-text (STT) and pure Python 128d X-Vector speaker diarization framework for Android Termux. Integrates Whisper.cpp, Vosk, and Sherpa-ONNX.
- **Packages**: PyPI `pip install termux-stt` | npm `npm install termux-stt`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/stt/
- **Audio Showcase**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/stt/showcase.html
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/stt/llms.txt

### 4. Termux-Train
- **Description**: Lightweight DAG autograd tensor and on-device LoRA training framework built for Android Bionic ARM64 without PyTorch dependency.
- **Package**: PyPI `pip install termux-train`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/train/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/train/llms.txt

### 5. Termux-Playwright
- **Description**: Non-root headless Chromium automation framework for Android Termux with persistent disk ledger recovery (.tp_ledger) and prototype-safe stealth.
- **Packages**: PyPI `pip install termux-playwright` | npm `npm install termux-playwright`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/playwright/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/playwright/llms.txt

### 6. Termux-Diffusion
- **Description**: Bionic ARM64 native on-device Stable Diffusion runtime for Android Termux and Samsung Galaxy hardware.
- **Packages**: PyPI `pip install termux-diffusion` | npm `npm install termux-diffusion`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/diffusion/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/diffusion/llms.txt

### 7. AMEVA Sentinel
- **Description**: Privacy-first security observability and deterministic threat scoring layer for web applications. Zero raw coordinates/keystrokes collected, mathematical policy evaluation, cross-browser verified across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
- **Packages**: npm `npm install @ameva/sentinel@alpha @ameva/sentinel-browser@alpha @ameva/sentinel-risk-core@alpha`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.github.io/ameva-sentinel/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-sentinel
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/sentinel/llms.txt

### 8. Termux-BitNet
- **Description**: 1.58-bit ternary quantized large language model inference runtime optimized for ARM64 NEON SIMD instructions on mobile devices.
- **Package**: PyPI `pip install termux-bitnet`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/bitnet/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/bitnet/llms.txt

### 9. Termux-LlamaCPP
- **Description**: Native GGUF model execution runtime for Android Termux, utilizing OpenBLAS NEON CPU acceleration and Vulkan GPGPU offloading.
- **Package**: PyPI `pip install termux-llamacpp`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/llamacpp/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/llamacpp/llms.txt

### 10. Termux-MCP
- **Description**: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and client implementation providing standardized tool-calling infrastructure for on-device autonomous agents.
- **Packages**: PyPI `pip install termux-mcp` | npm `npm install termux-mcp`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/mcp/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/mcp/llms.txt

### 11. Termux-Vision
- **Description**: On-device computer vision engine with lightweight multimodal embedding extraction and visual perception pipelines.
- **Package**: PyPI `pip install termux-vision`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/vision/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/vision/llms.txt

### 12. AMEVA-Runtime (Vulkan Compute)
- **Description**: Hardware-accelerated GPGPU compute runtime providing direct Vulkan 1.3 subgroup math kernels for Adreno and Mali mobile GPUs.
- **Package**: PyPI `pip install ameva-runtime`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/vulkan/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/vulkan/llms.txt

### 13. Termux-TTS
- **Description**: On-device text-to-speech synthesis pipeline featuring multi-speaker neural vocoders and streaming audio buffers.
- **Packages**: PyPI `pip install termux-tts` | npm `npm install termux-tts`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/tts/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/tts/llms.txt

### 14. Termux-AIChain
- **Description**: Directed acyclic graph (DAG) multi-agent orchestration and distributed peer-to-peer agent communication mesh.
- **Package**: PyPI `pip install termux-aichain`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/aichain/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/aichain/llms.txt

### 15. Termux-Cluster
- **Description**: Edge device cluster management, distributed work-stealing scheduler, and live hardware fleet telemetry synchronization.
- **Package**: PyPI `pip install termux-cluster`
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/cluster/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/cluster/llms.txt

### 16. Termux-Privacy
- **Description**: Hardware fingerprint protection and cryptographic zero-knowledge telemetry mask for edge client privacy.
- **Documentation**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/privacy/
- **AI Context**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/lib/privacy/llms.txt

### 17. AMEVA Labs (Research & Disclosures)
- **Description**: Sovereign AI systems research laboratory and academic disclosure archive with peer-reviewed benchmarks and community discussion board.
- **Portal URL**: https://uno-km.vercel.app/labs/

## Quick Installation Matrix

```bash
# Python Packages:
pip install ameva                    # AMEVA-Forge WebGPU Autograd
pip install termux-stt               # Termux-STT Audio Recognition
pip install termux-train             # Termux-Train LoRA Engine
pip install termux-playwright        # Termux-Playwright Automation
pip install termux-diffusion         # Termux-Diffusion Image Generation
pip install termux-bitnet            # Termux-BitNet 1.58-bit Inference
pip install termux-llamacpp          # Termux-LlamaCPP GGUF Engine
pip install termux-mcp               # Termux-MCP Edge Hub
pip install termux-vision            # Termux-Vision Multimodal
pip install ameva-runtime            # AMEVA-Runtime Vulkan Compute
pip install termux-tts               # Termux-TTS Voice Synthesis
pip install termux-aichain           # Termux-AIChain Multi-Agent DAG
pip install termux-cluster           # Termux-Cluster Fleet Swarm

# Node.js / TypeScript Packages:
npm install @ameva/sentinel@alpha    # AMEVA-Sentinel Privacy Security SDK
npm install termux-stt               # Termux-STT Node.js
npm install termux-playwright        # Termux-Playwright Node.js
npm install termux-diffusion         # Termux-Diffusion Node.js
npm install termux-mcp               # Termux-MCP Node.js
npm install termux-tts               # Termux-TTS Node.js
```
